target: A funny, socially complicated Delhi protest day where people and vehicles physically enact persistent decisions.
quality_rule: A state change is not complete until its physical action, feedback, interruption and remembered consequence are tested.

research.collection: Signed-in authorised Instagram account; direct reel links, observed beats, caption/date provenance, representative comments; no invented collection quota.
research.analysis: Separate observation, comic interpretation and fictional adaptation. Seek deadpan practicality, mutual embarrassment, status reversal, bravado hiding anxiety, friendship obligations and crowd participation.
research.status: Current browser policy service failure blocks new signed-in observations. Existing records and original fiction remain usable with explicit labels.

deliverables: Mesh/collider agreement for tables, bins, bollards and buildings
Aid tent walls/posts/roof with traversable doorway
Reach and line-of-sight interaction checks
Valid path endpoint and connector segments
acceptance: Walk into and out of tent
Jump onto and off bench/table without penetration
Blocked map click does not create endless walk
Cannot talk or pick up through walls/floors

deliverables: Stable actor archetypes distinct from display roles
Corroboration requires accessible source
Evidence provenance exposed in inspector
acceptance: Command pressure changes officer action scores
Distant truth does not raise confidence
Local witness can corroborate with recorded source

deliverables: Individual voice and contradiction cards
Multi-beat scenes with interruptions and reversals
Motivation-based choices without good/bad labels
acceptance: Dialogue identifiable without speaker labels
Joke changes with audience and relationship
Quiet or failed response remains playable
No automatic lecture after every risky joke

deliverables: Two independently scheduled vehicles
Door/stop/boarding/seating/travel states
Cabin-local player and NPC passenger positions
Persistent routes, seats and occupancy
acceptance: No boarding a moving bus
No double-booked seat
Movement continuous between stops
Reload preserves passenger and vehicle positions
Blocked exit refuses safely

deliverables: Modelled cabin with aisle, seats, handrails and usable door
Exterior and interior use one vehicle transform
Interactive passengers and driver
Routes to distinct explorable destinations
Exterior collisions and braking around pedestrians
acceptance: Walk to stop, board, move in cabin, sit, converse, ride, alight, explore and return
Player does not slide out as bus turns
Route never clips a building
Inventory and companions remain consistent

deliverables: Action lifecycle: proposed, reserved, approaching, performing, interrupted, completed
Supplies have stock, holders and destinations
NPC goals select visible tasks instead of generic gestures
Orders have sender, recipient, acknowledgement, refusal and cost
acceptance: Supply changes only after delivery
Occupied actor cannot accept incompatible tasks
Interruption releases reservations
Inspector traces the exact decision inputs and action result

deliverables: Transport forecourt
Arcade market interior with shuttered and open shops
Service courtyard and delivery access
Connecting lanes with multiple pedestrian routes
Activities and residents appropriate to each area
acceptance: Each area supports at least one interaction loop and two meaningful destinations
Walking and transit destinations agree with map
No decorative doorway presented as enterable
Route coverage includes vehicle footprint, not just point pathfinding

deliverables: Scheduled pressures plus state-triggered events
Negotiation delays and competing group orders
Local escalation and dispersal enacted by actor movement
Ending assembled from fulfilled, refused and interrupted commitments
acceptance: Same seed with different actions changes timing and actor conduct, not only counters
Ignoring player still produces a coherent day
No universal correct route
Player knowledge and developer truth stay separate

deliverables: Participant presence and staging gate
Gaze, pause, reaction and return-control beats
Forward-facing readable signs and obstruction-aware camera
Original or cleared voice/music assets
Animation transitions, foot placement and contact review
acceptance: Conversation camera shows actual participants
No caption-only substitute for a performed comic scene
Audio timing reviewed by listening
Continuous full-day playtest and hostile physics routes pass
Measured frame times meet an agreed target on user's browser

release_rule: Do not call the vision complete from unit tests or encounter counts. Keep staged integration distinct from completed playable features.
